items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I was named for Clifford Spencer -- was after my grandfather.

ctx.x: Oh yeah? Well, you didn't give it to me. That's the reason I ask.
Well, I never liked it so I never used it. I was named for Clifford Spencer -- was after my grandfather.
Well, for the record now, we know that you did have a middle name.
